abort.mqtt_not_configured: Home Assistant messaging (MQTT) is not set up. Please install and enable the MQTT integration, then try again.
abort.use_zeroconf: Cala devices advertise themselves on the network. When one is discovered it will appear in the list above. Ensure the device is powered on and on the same network.
abort.invalid_discovery: Invalid discovery information. Please try again.
abort.reauth_successful: Reconnected successfully. The Cala integration has been reloaded.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device at {url}: {error_detail}. The pairing server only runs while the heater is showing the Home Assistant screen (Settings → Advanced → Home Assistant) — open that screen, check the IP/host, and try again. Home Assistant and the heater may be on different subnets as long as routing between them is allowed.
error.pairing_rejected: The device answered but did not return pairing credentials ({error_detail}). Make sure the heater is on a firmware version that supports Home Assistant and try again.
error.mqtt_not_configured: Home Assistant messaging (MQTT) is not set up. Please install and enable the MQTT integration, then try again.
error.invalid_host: A valid device host or IP address is required.
error.invalid_code: The device could not decrypt the request, which almost always means the pairing code is wrong. Re-read the six-digit code on the heater’s Settings → Advanced → Home Assistant screen and try again. (Device said: {error_detail})
error.invalid_device_id: The pairing code was accepted, but the device rejected the device ID “{device_id}”. Use the exact ID shown on the discovered card or the heater (e.g. 260121B006) — not the IP address. (Device said: {error_detail})
error.device_error: The device returned an unexpected response: {error_detail}
error.device_id_required: A device ID is required. It is the serial shown on the discovered card (e.g. 260121B006).

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Enter the Cala device network details. The device ID is the serial shown on the discovered card and printed on the heater (e.g. 260121B006) — not its IP address.

data_description.device_id: Serial such as 260121B006. Using the IP address here makes the device reject the pairing.

pair.description: Enter the pairing code shown on the Cala device (device_id: {device_id}).

provision.description:
To pair your Cala you need to get the pairing code from the device: Settings → Advanced → Home Assistant.
Please create a unique MQTT username and password in your MQTT broker. Enter those credentials here.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Broker host and port. Most users can leave these as default.

reprovision.title: Re-provision device
reprovision.description: Update the pairing code, MQTT broker, or credentials. Enter the device IP if needed (find it in your router or device display).
